title: Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship (AGES)
duration: Not stated on the official page; the award is funded through the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund
description: The Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship recognizes outstanding academic achievement of students pursuing graduate studies in Alberta. It was established to incent the best and the brightest students, including international students, to study in Alberta, and is funded through the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund. The award is between $11,000 and $15,000. Applicants must be enrolled full-time in a master's, doctoral or ladderable graduate programme at an eligible Alberta post-secondary institution while living in Alberta, and eligible statuses include Canadian citizens, Permanent Residents

title: Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE) - Fonds de recherche du Quebec
official_source: Fonds de recherche du Quebec (FRQ) - secteur Nature et technologies, commissioned by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec
program_type: Provincial research scholarship administered by the Fonds de recherche du Quebec on behalf of the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec
duration: Master's: maximum 6 instalments (6 semesters). Doctoral: maximum 12 sessions (12 instalments), with $25,000 for the first 9 sessions and $12,000 for the last 3 if an extension is requested. Postdoctoral: maximum 12 months, not renewable. Short-term research or professional development: 4 months, not renewable.
description: In support of the Quebec government's science policy, the Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students (PBEEE) supports the internationalization of research activities in Quebec higher education institutions, attracts top foreign researchers and students, and creates cultural links for joint research projects. It is managed by the Fonds de recherche du Quebec - secteur Nature et technologies, which was commissioned by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec, which provides the funding. title: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
program_type: Federal research training award (Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program)
description: The Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program recognizes and empowers the next generation of highly qualified innovators, knowledge workers and creative thinkers. It supports outstanding postdoctoral researchers in developing their research skills and provides the funding and flexibility needed to support their contributions to building world-class research capacity and to Canada's prosperity and competitiveness. For the September 2026 competition SSHRC publishes a value and duration of $70,000 per year for 2 years, with an application deadline of September 10, 2026 at 8:00 p.m. eastern.

title: Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development - Phase 2 (SEED-2)
duration: Four to eight months: college/undergraduate 4 months or 8 months (two academic terms); graduate 4 months or 5 to 6 months. Scholarships cannot be deferred and are not renewable.
description: The Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development - Phase 2 (SEED-2) program is offered by Global Affairs Canada as a key initiative under Canada's Indo-Pacific Strategy, funded under that strategy. title: Schulich Leader Scholarships
official_source: Schulich Leader Scholarships (funded by the Schulich Foundation, administered by UJA Federation of Greater Toronto)
description: Schulich Leader Scholarships are Canada's largest undergraduate STEM scholarship programme, launched in 2012 from a CAD 200 million fund. One hundred awards are made each year across 20 partner universities, half worth CAD 120,000 for engineering and half worth CAD 100,000 for science, technology and math, and the funds are disbursed directly by the university over the degree. Every high school or cegep in Canada may nominate one graduating student per year, who then submits a separate scholarship application with two referees.

title: UCAS Scholarship for International Students
official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
program_type: University-funded scholarship administered by UCAS International Students Office
description: The UCAS Scholarship for International Students is a University of Chinese Academy of Sciences award for non-Chinese-citizen students pursuing a Master's or doctoral degree, or attending courses, conducting research or making academic visits at UCAS colleges and CAS institutes. It has two tiers: a full scholarship covering tuition waiver, application fee waiver, monthly stipend, basic accommodation and medical insurance, and a partial scholarship covering only the tuition waiver, insurance and application fee. Awards run for no longer than 36 months, and the full tier publishes RMB 40,000/year

title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2026
official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
duration: PhD: monthly stipend for up to 48 months. Master's: monthly stipend for up to 36 months. The official page states the scholarship duration explicitly in the Admission Notice.
description: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program), previously the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents, is the postgraduate scholarship of the Alliance of National and International Science Organizations for the Belt and Road Regions (ANSO), sponsored by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) and administered at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) for master's and PhD study. The 2026 call opened for application on 15 October 2025 and closed for applicants and referees on 31 January 2026 Beijing Time; results were announced in June 2026 and the 2027 call was not yet published on 2026-10-0
